description: This file defines the EndpointProviderV2 class in the AWS SDK for PHP, responsible for resolving service endpoints based on input parameters and a ruleset, with caching support.

classes.name: EndpointProviderV2
classes.description: Provides endpoint resolution functionality given a ruleset and input parameters, with caching.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the EndpointProviderV2 with a ruleset and partitions, setting up internal cache.

methods.name: getRuleset
methods.description: Returns the Ruleset object used for endpoint evaluation.

methods.name: resolveEndpoint
methods.description: Resolves an endpoint based on input parameters, utilizing caching for efficiency, or throws an exception if resolution fails.

methods.name: hashInputParameters
methods.description: Create a hash of input parameters for caching purposes.
